summary: Reflected on Samsung 2023 ChatGPT leaks: would not paste DATABASE_URL, API keys, JWT_SECRET, invite tokens, or invitee emails into a public model. Prefer local repo-aware agents and zero-retention tenants over a blanket ban that fails at 11pm.
evidence: Would not paste secrets or live tokens; this app already redacts emails in emit_log as [REDACTED_EMAIL] — prompts should be at least that strict.
Middle path: env-only secrets, zero-retention/enterprise or on-prem model, DLP on paste, local agent reads the repo instead of Ctrl+V into a consumer chat.
Blanket ban fails under ship pressure; inbound review of what leaves the building is the same skill as outbound review of AI output.
